title: Expression orale — to template
objective: Tutor daily. The three speaking tasks as reflexes. Fluency beats accuracy here.
tasks: Tutor DAILY — if you ration the budget anywhere, don't ration it here

steps.title: Tâche 1 (~2 min, no prep) — entretien dirigé
steps.body:
The examiner asks about **you**: name, work, family, city, hobbies, plans. Answer in full, connected sentences — never one word.
Have a ready 60-second *présentation* (who, work, where, since when with **depuis**, why French/Canada) and expand each answer with *parce que* + one detail.

steps.title: Tâche 2 (~5½ min incl. 2 min prep) — YOU ask the questions
steps.body:
You get a document (an ad, an offer) and the examiner plays the seller/manager. **You ask 10–12 questions** — price, dates, conditions, availability — and react.
This is where your **ten question frames** from week 3 and **conditional politeness** from week 9 score. Ask for clarification (*Pardon, vous pourriez répéter ?*), negotiate (*Serait-il possible de … ?*).

steps.title: Tâche 3 (~4½ min) — defend an opinion, no notes
steps.body:
One structure across all sixteen themes until the shape is reflex:
**Position → argument 1 + example → argument 2 → other side → conclusion.**

steps.title: The thing to internalise
steps.body:
**Fluency beats accuracy here.** A candidate who speaks continuously with several small errors scores above one who is accurate but halting.
**Never stop to repair a gender.**
Fillers that buy thinking time: *C'est une bonne question… · Ce qu'il faut voir, c'est que… · Je dirais que… · Disons que… · Comment dire… · Si je comprends bien, vous voulez dire que…*

steps.q: Mid-sentence you realise you said *le* instead of *la*. What do you do?
steps.explain: Never stop to repair a gender. Continuity is scored; a single gender slip barely is.

steps.q: In which speaking task are YOU the one asking questions?

steps.title: Tâche 1 — 2 minutes
steps.task: Answer as if the examiner asked: *Présentez-vous. Parlez-moi de votre travail, de votre ville et de vos loisirs.* Keep talking for the full 2 minutes.

steps.title: Tâche 2 — 2 min prep + 3½ min
steps.task: Document: *« À louer — appartement 3 pièces, Montréal (Plateau). 1 450 $/mois. Proche métro. Libre le 1er mars. Contactez M. Tremblay. »* You call the landlord. Ask 10–12 questions (charges, deposit, pets, heating, visit this weekend…) and negotiate.
steps.prompt: Vous appelez M. Tremblay au sujet de l'appartement à louer.

steps.title: Tâche 3 — 4½ minutes, no notes
steps.task: Defend your opinion. Use at least three fillers on purpose.
steps.prompt: « L'intelligence artificielle va remplacer les médecins. » Qu'en pensez-vous ?

points: T1 = the examiner interviews you — full sentences, depuis, parce que + detail
T2 = YOU ask 10–12 questions from a document + conditional politeness
Fluency > accuracy; fillers buy time; never stop for a gender

options: Est-ce que les charges sont comprises dans le loyer ?
